notes: The social calendar: seasonal programmes built from the catalogue. 'when' is a fixed start (MM-DD), a movable feast (dates per year below) or the nth weekday of a month, each with a length in days. 'rule' uses the shelf rule fields (media, languages, any_tags, all_tags, min_strength); fallback_media fills a programme when its main media run short. 'order': gentle (least intense first, the scariest on the last day), strength (closest match first) or chronological. When there are fewer picks than days, picks are spaced across the window.
